notes.title: Try HordeCore on Steam
notes.content:
Did you hear the news? Our friends at META Publishing are working on an awesome game: HordeCore.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/980210/HordeCore/] HordeCore [/url] It is a cool side-scrolling shooter, where you blast the hordes of angry Hordelings! Make your kick-ass team of survivors and join the fight!

Moreover, you could already try it absolutely free on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1421960/HordeCore_Training_Ground/

Check it out alone or join the group of up to 4 friends using Steam Remote Play!

notes.title: Low FPS bug fixed.
notes.content: This update fixes the game's unstable performance on weak computers running on Windows 7.
